page.layout: Two columns of running text on one printed page, with a heading above the first column; the left margin holds marginal notes and the right column of text runs to the bottom. The gloss-like marginal words in the left margin are the printed notes. Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.head: De Lucio.
main_text.p: Lucius alia à lu- NOn leuem inter celebres autores diglatiationem concitauit lucius, fe-po pifcis re enim omnes lupum appellandum est,ille cenfuerant non luciùm, propterea quod in enim flu- pifces non fecus ac lupus in oues graffetur viatilis, Verum hic error docte pariter ac diligenter hic mari- à Paulo Iouio explofus eft. Porro Aufonius mus: in Mofella de lucio ita canit:
main_text.l: Hic etiam Latio rifus praenomine culter
Obfidet, hic nullos mecafarum leclus ad vfu,
main_text.p: Ex quibus intelligere facile eft, olim nullo in honore menfarum fuifle.

Nunc paffim inter lautiffimos pifces amnicos annumeratur. Certum autem eft quasdam gentes parum luciis delectariorum marinorum præsertim abundantiam. Et Italiparua in gloria eos habent, ob saporem infuauem ac pene fastidiosum. Gulofiffimus enim est & voracissimus, precipueque carniuorus, suique generis piscibus vescitur gratiffime, ficut & ranis. Quin tanta est gula hujus piscis, vt anserculosa ana-ticulasque in aquis natantes deglutiat. Qui in fluuiis rapidis ac putis aluntur magis commendantur, limofum virus gustatu re-ferens-

page.notes: Printed page is a scan with show-through from the facing page; the text reads continuously in two blocks. Some words in the left margin are marginal notes whose exact wording is partly illegible on the scan; those readings are approximate. Several long-s words and the ligatures in the verse lines are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The verse lines in the middle are set as separate lines and were treated as lines of verse. The opening drop capital N is joined to "On". The final lines in the lower right are partly cut off by the scan edge and may be incomplete.
